headline: Knee-high SE dribble with a glassy dawn — log it early or skip it.
today: Small SE swell, 0.7-1.1ft at fair period, so nothing to write home about. Dawn cross-off into a light W morning is your only clean window before the SSE onshore fills in by afternoon and turns it to junk. Grab the log and a coffee, go before noon or don't bother.

daysToWatch.note: Biggest local day at 2-2.4ft on a good SE angle with light W cross winds morning — short period but rideable, best before the afternoon SW cross-on. Groveler or fish.
Smaller at 1.2-1.7ft but N offshore morning glass and a good angle. Clean dawn longboard session if you're staying home.
